changelog.summary: Security audit hardening: reject broad project dirs (/, $HOME, top-level folders), narrow sync-code to git-tracked explicit source extensions with no dotfiles/dotdirs/CSV/PDF/JSON, block HF/AWS/WandB/DB-URL/password=/webhook credentials & ID cards & table phones, enforce local provenance.json for code/ and artifacts/, bind push --confirm-hash to un-truncated preview digest, support deletion sync & 60s push timeout, persist collaborators & force local noreply git author, trial-lockdown auto-in-allowlist and sessions/, harden advisor_collect.py against symlinks (core.symlinks=false + index check), untrusted invites (--allow-student allowlist), and prompt injection (<untrusted_student_data>).

Directory-jailed seamless research sync: default collaborator narrowed to advisor taoyao2005 only, allowlist-jailed code/ and weekly/<W>/artifacts/ up to 10 MiB, dual-track evidence+judgment alignment, and advisor_collect.py code-auditable digest.
Handle GitHub personal repo HTTP 422 fallback when assigning pull permission, add --collaborators option on init, and clarify personal vs org repo collaborator permissions.
